name: Etna Diadem intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

d4.say: Cryo salve, for burns of both kinds. Where you are going, the cold can scald worse than any flare.

d2.say: The deep current turns toward Neptune. The cold ones gather what the bright one sheds. We do not judge them — winter teaches its own prayers. But we remember everything.

d1.say: Welcome, traveler. Sit. The geysers are singing tonight.

options.label: Hurry
options.text: No time to sit. The sun is dying.

d2h.say: The sun is not dying. It is being SPENT. There is a difference, and the difference is a choice. ...Sit anyway. The geysers insist.
